title: Is DLSS 4 actually BULLS**T?? --- THE RTX 5090 BLIND TEST
description:
I have an RTX 5090! ANNNDD the Embargo is UP! Which means I can actually show you stuff. Nvidia has been marketing the 5090 as "2x faster than a 4090", but that is using DLSS 4 technology and especially Multi-Frame Generation (MFG). I've been sniffing this out for a while, so let's put it to the TEST. This video is full of blind tests to see if these settings are even worth using and the results will surprise you (I kinda like it a little bit sometimes, maybe).
